description.value: Taverna Greka is a family-run Greek restaurant established in 1982 and now operated by Eleni and her daughters Koula and Lena. Situated on the Fraser River waterfront in New Westminster, the dining room overlooks tugboat traffic by day and the lit Pattullo Bridge by night. A short walk from Columbia SkyTrain Station, it offers traditional homemade dishes from spanakopita to lamb souvlaki, and can host groups in its main dining room (60 guests) or a private events room (40 guests).
